newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday with Audi shares up to $16.125 from $16 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares down to $12 from $12.25.
Solidere A shares rose slightly to $10.75 from $10.625 on Wednesday while B shares held steady, for the fourth successive day this week, at $11.125.
Turnover in Audi, which began trading at $15 last week, rose to 51,000 shares from 44,861 shares. Also traded on the BSE were 10,000 BLC shares compared with 5,500 a day earlier.
Banque Audi and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce are the first two Lebanese banks listed on the BSE since it reopened in January 1996.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 123,066 shares compared with 125,754 shares and value was $1,619,701 against $1,602,997.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.43 percent to 922.52 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.01 percent to 81.68.
